Description: EC2 security operations v0.2: retained archives, monthly export, notifications and approved critical isolation; requires existing IAM roles

CodeBucket.Description: Existing same-region private bucket containing the release Lambda ZIP

CodeKey.Description: Versioned release lambda.zip key; use a new key for each release

NotificationTopicArn.Description: Existing SNS topic with confirmed primary/deputy subscribers

InstanceIds.Description: JSON array of monitored instance IDs, at most 50

IsolationGroups.Description: JSON map of VPC ID to pre-created approved isolation SG

EndpointGroupIds.Description: JSON array of approved private SSM/Logs interface endpoint SG IDs

ActiveLogGroups.Description: JSON array of actually deployed source groups; remove unused OS groups

FindingTypes.Description: Required comma-separated primary-admin approved GuardDuty EC2 finding types
